group.name: Which body did you build in BodySlide?

plugin.name: CBBE 3BA (3BBB)
plugin.description: For a body built from the CBBE 3BA / 3BBB slider set. Belly uses PregnancyBelly; breasts blend BreastsNewSH, DoubleMelon, BreastsSmall and BreastWidth for a fuller shape rather than maxing one slider. All five slider names verified against CBBE 3BA Reference.osp. Pick this if you built 3BA - it is more accurate than the generic CBBE option.

plugin.name: CBBE (generic)
plugin.description: For a body built from a plain CBBE slider set, or any body whose sliders follow CBBE naming. Belly uses PregnancyBelly; breasts try BreastsSH and BreastsNewSH together, since plain CBBE sets vary in which one they ship. A slider your body lacks simply does nothing - but a body that has BOTH will grow roughly twice as much, so prefer the 3BA option if you built 3BA.

plugin.name: BHUNP
plugin.description: For a body built from the BHUNP (UUNP-derived) slider set. NOTE: these slider names are UNVERIFIED - no BHUNP body was available to check them against, unlike the CBBE 3BA and UBE profiles. If inflation does nothing after installing this, open your BHUNP body's .osp in a text editor and copy the exact Slider name values into an overlay at Data\SLIFNG\Bodies\Regions\zz-bhunp-fix.ini - see the README.txt in that folder. An overlay survives updates; editing default.ini directly does not.

plugin.name: None - node scaling (SLIF default)
plugin.description: No body profile: every target is driven by a skeleton NODE scale, exactly what SexLab Inflation Framework itself does out of the box (its shipped morph config has every slider percentage at zero). Pick this for a body not listed here, for a mixed setup you have not sorted out yet, or to look identical to real SLIF. Needs XPMSSE (which you almost certainly have). UBE characters still get their race-matched morph profile.
